description: List the applications in an organization — an application is the top-level container that owns environments, which in turn own secrets. Start here when you know the org but not the app slug the other tools need. Returns [{ id, orgId, name, slug, createdAt }]; use list_envs next to descend into one.

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: list_apps
